verdict.rationale: Daily is a real-time video/audio SDK, so in-session data exchange is a fair axis. However, the evidence pack never documents a data API for sending arbitrary participant-to-participant messages alongside media. DTMF delivery and server-side webhooks are different features, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes show only that documentation exists, not that a data API does.

support.subject: As a developer, participants exchange low-latency arbitrary data in the session alongside audio and video, with a documented data API
